summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, disclosing on-market share repurchases. Between June 22 and June 26, 2026, the company repurchased 990,900 shares at HKD 50.4213 per share (approx. USD 6.46), held as treasury shares, representing 0.0561% of existing issued shares. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the repurchases are part of a disclosed share buyback program. Mechanics: repurchased shares are kept in treasury, not cancelled, reducing shares outstanding. Watch for continuation of buyback pace and potential cancellation or resale of treasury shares.
